title: A line typed over a fixed price is in Manual
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, in category A, cost $10.00, fixed sell price $12.50.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with that inventory part with its price typed over to $15.00, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customer B in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • The Manual row reads Parts Cost $10.00 and Parts Invoiced $15.00 for the category A part ($15.00 − $10.00 = $5.00 margin).
  • No Fixed price row shows.
